working: Traffic is holding steady and slightly up: 150 sessions in the last 7 days vs 149 the prior 7, and 588 in the last 30 days vs 574 the prior 30 (+2.4%).
Referral is the fastest-growing channel: 83 sessions in the last 30 days vs 51 the prior 30 (+63%), and 21 vs 11 week over week.
Alumni eNews - July 2026 (sent 07-09) is the strongest send of the year: 57.3% open rate and +77.2% session lift (14.5 -> 25.7 daily sessions) off just 1,028 sends.
Open rates are far above the 25-35% health/nonprofit benchmark: 47.0% average across the 29 sends in 2026, and 51.6% across all 100 campaigns on record (317,115 total sends).
Organic Search remains the biggest earned channel at 259 sessions in the last 30 days (44% of the period) and 10,720 sessions / 33.5% of the full 1,100-day window.
not_working: UTM leakage is the single biggest measurement gap: across 29 sends in 2026 GA4 recorded only 12 Email sessions in the 3-day windows after sends, against 1,255 Direct sessions in those same windows. Newsletter links are missing UTM tags, so GA4 books email traffic as Direct — which is why Direct is 50.6% (16,187 sessions) of the whole window.
Click rates are well below benchmark: 1.18% average across 2026 sends, with the two most recent at 0.43% (Staff-Client eNews - July, 0.89% click-to-open) and 1.04% (Referring Partners eNews - July).
The Staff-Client list is the largest (8,906 sends) but the weakest performer: -27.3% lift on 07-20 and -25.3% on 07-02, both negative against baseline.
Organic Social is shrinking: 18 sessions in the last 30 days vs 31 the prior 30 (-42%), now only 5.4% of the full window.
The Referring Partners list opens at 27.4% (07-20) and 26.5% (06-29) — the bottom of the 25-35% benchmark band and roughly 20 points below the Alumni list.
Search visibility is stuck on page two: 1,546 impressions over the last 7 days across 68 pages at an impression-weighted average position of 20.1, converting to only 5 clicks.
Constant Contact still is not authorizing — this run failed again with 401 invalid_client on token refresh, so campaign data is frozen at the 2026-07-20 send. Nothing after that date is measurable.

Move the Staff-Client send off its current slot. Both July Staff-Client sends came in negative (-27.3%, -25.3%), while the Alumni sends on 07-09 (Thu), 06-03 (Wed) and 05-19 (Tue) delivered +77.2%, +65.2% and +66.5%.
Dig into the Referral surge (+63% over 30 days, 83 sessions) to identify the driving sources and decide whether to reinforce them — it is the only channel growing right now.

summary: Traffic is flat-to-slightly-up (588 sessions in 30 days, +2.4%) with Referral up 63% and Organic Social down 42%; email open rates stay excellent at 47% but clicks are weak at 1.18% and untagged links keep pushing newsletter traffic into Direct (1,255 Direct vs 12 Email sessions after 2026 sends). Constant Contact authorization is still broken, so campaign data has not advanced past the 2026-07-20 send.
